answer.reason: Exodus 17 tells what Hur did, and Exodus 24 adds that he was left in charge with Aaron; the other verses are genealogy or only name him as Bezaleel's grandfather.

clauses.english: helped Aaron hold up Moses' hands until Israel won the battle against Amalek
clauses.quote: Aaron and Hur stayed up his hands

clauses.english: was left with Aaron to judge the elders' matters while Moses was on the mount
clauses.quote: Aaron and Hur are with you: if any man have any matters to do, let him come unto them.

doubts: The genealogical verses in 1 Chronicles 2 and 4 may concern other men named Hur, or only list him, so they were left out.
The verses naming Bezaleel as son of Hur only give kinship, so no clause rests on them.
